title: platform.json
description: Release manifest published as an asset of every ai-native release (release.yml, M4.2). Lists component versions and sha256 digests, and the real executable status of each capability (P25 in parity/v2.0.5/capabilities.json: a capability is never claimed 'available' here unless it is 'executable').

digest.description: sha256 of the release bundle tarball.

components.description: Internal version of each sub-contract this release ships, independent of the platform version itself (governance/versioning/VERSIONING-POLICY.md).

evidence.description: Path to the test or validator that proves 'executable', if applicable.

sbom.description: Path of the CycloneDX SBOM asset within the release.

provenance.description: Path of the sigstore attestation bundle asset within the release.
